subject: Webinar: Speaker prep, rehearsal windows & backup plan
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Webinar: Speaker prep, rehearsal windows & backup plan

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for agreeing to join our webinar on May 27. Attached is the draft run-of-show and a slides template (see attachments). A few asks so we can finalize logistics:

- Can you confirm which 30–40 minute slot you prefer to take (talk + 5–10 Q&A)? We have 12:15–1:00pm PT or 3:00–3:45pm PT available.
- Please send your headshot (PNG) and 1–2 sentence bio by EOD Tuesday (5/12).
- We’d like your final deck by Monday 5/25 so we can stage it in the streaming studio.

Two operational items I also want to call out: the emcee (Laura) will do a 20-minute dry run with you on 5/26. We also need a short backup plan in case you have connectivity issues — option A is that you send us a prerecorded 12-minute clip of the core demo; option B is that one of our internal SMEs (Monica or Vivek) can present on your behalf if we need to pivot. Could you let us know which fallback you prefer?

Attaching: speaker_agenda_v3.pdf, slides_template_redwood.pptx

Appreciate it — looking forward to the session.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Dylan —

Thanks for the clear note. 12:15–1:00pm PT works best for me. I’ll get headshot and bio to you by Tuesday 5/12. Final deck — I can commit to 5/25.

Regarding backups: I’d prefer option A (prerecorded 12–15 minute clip of the demo). If something comes up and I can’t join live, please run that clip and have Monica introduce it. I’ll record and upload to the drive by 5/24 as a precaution.

Two quick questions:
- Is there a hard slide count or max file size for the streaming studio?
- Can you confirm whether the Q&A will be moderated (Laura) or live Chat?

Best,

Date: 2026-05-13T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized rehearsal + backup protocol (see attachments)

Team and Sara —

Final plan below and in the attached emcee script. Please review and flag anything urgent.

Rehearsal windows:
- Technical dry run (studio ingest + audio check): 2026-05-26 09:00–09:30 PT (studio ops + producer)
- Content dry run with Laura: 2026-05-26 11:00–11:30 PT (recorded, we’ll walk slides and transitions)

Backup protocol (executive summary):
- Primary: Sara presents live.
- If Sara loses connectivity within first 5 minutes: play prerecorded clip; Laura to introduce and handle live Q&A.
- If Sara is unreachable before show start: Vivek to present using condensed handoff deck (Vivek to rehearse 5/24–5/25 with Monica).
- Producer will keep the prerecorded file staged on the streaming machine (file: sara_demo_prerec.mp4).

Attachments: emcee_script_v2.docx (sample intros, segues, seeded Qs), speaker_agenda_v3.pdf, slides_template_redwood.pptx

Logistics notes: please name final slides as LASTNAME_Acme_Redwood_May27.pptx and upload to the Drive folder by 5/25 17:00 PT. Max file size: 300MB. We will also accept a PDF fallback. Q&A will be moderated by Laura; attendees can submit questions via Chat and we’ll reserve 10 min at the end for live answers.

Dylan
